m: वावाता f. a king's favourite wife (accord. to Sch. inferior to the महिषी, but superior to the परि-वृक्ती), Br.; GṛŚrS.; R.

वावहि mfn. (fr. Intens. of √ वह्) carrying or conducting well, RV.
